evals.prompt: I want to start improving code quality in this project. Please run a Pomona scan to find code quality issues — look at our code for linting rule violations, stale TODO/FIXME comments, dead code (unused imports, commented-out blocks), and test coverage gaps. Create a prioritized backlog file (pomona-backlog.md) at the project root with the findings categorized P1-P4 using the benefit x ease-of-review matrix. Don't make any code changes yet — just produce the backlog so I can review what you found and decide what to tackle first.
evals.expected_output: A pomona-backlog.md file with prioritized code quality tasks
expectations: The backlog file pomona-backlog.md was created at the project root
Tasks are categorized into at least 2 priority levels (P1-P4)
At least one task from the static analysis category (linting rule violations or type checking)
At least one task from the TODO/dead code audit category
Each task entry includes a file path reference
The backlog format follows the specified structure with description, file, and source fields

evals.prompt: I've noticed some TODO comments and commented-out code blocks have been accumulating in our project. Please run the Pomona TODO/dead code audit scanner to find them. Search for TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comments, classify each one, and also find commented-out code blocks (more than 3 consecutive commented lines) and unused imports. Create a backlog entry for each finding with the right priority level. Save results to a todo-audit-report.md file at the project root so I can review them. Don't make any code changes.
evals.expected_output: A todo-audit-report.md file listing TODO comments, dead code, and commented-out blocks with priorities
expectations: The report file todo-audit-report.md was created at the project root
TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX comments were searched and classified
Commented-out code blocks (>3 lines) were identified
Each finding has a priority level assigned (P1-P4)
Findings include file paths and line references

evals.prompt: I'd like to try the full Pomona continuous improvement cycle on this project. Set up the pomona-backlog.md, run the scanning workflow to fill it with prioritized tasks, then pick the highest-priority P1 task and implement the fix. Make the change small (~10 lines of diff as Pomona recommends). After making the change, write the commit message and PR description as specified by Pomona so I can see what would be submitted. Save the PR description to pomona-pr-description.md at the project root. Validate your changes with the project's linting commands if available.
evals.expected_output: A pomona-backlog.md with scanned tasks, a small code fix, and a pomona-pr-description.md with the PR description
expectations: A pomona-backlog.md file exists with scanned tasks in at least 2 priority levels
A code change was made (diff is non-empty)
The code change is small (roughly 10 lines of diff)
A pomona-pr-description.md file was created with a PR title and description
The PR title includes an AI-generated indicator prefix
The PR description leads with concrete outcomes for engineers
The backlog was updated to reflect the completed task
